objective: Diagnosticar en solo lectura por que sync_comercial_v2 sigue sin terminar despues de R7 aunque HEADER-FIRST y heartbeat estan integrados. Identificar en que sucursal se detiene cada INCR reciente, el orden efectivo de avance y si existe lock/ejecucion colgada. No modificar codigo ni datos. No tocar sync_comercial_abiertas_v2. Etiqueta: Sincronizador.

queries.name: recent_auto_run_unit_sequence
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (100) s.run_id,s.run_timestamp,u.codigo,u.nombre,s.fecha_inicio,s.fecha_fin,s.status,s.source_connection_status,s.error_code,s.error_message FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 s LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio u ON CONVERT(varchar(36),u.id)=CONVERT(varchar(36),s.unidad_negocio_id) WHERE s.run_type='INCREMENTAL' AND s.run_id LIKE 'INCR-%' AND s.run_timestamp>=DATEADD(hour,-8,SYSUTCDATETIME()) ORDER BY s.run_timestamp DESC

queries.name: recent_run_counts_named
queries.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT s.run_id,MIN(s.run_timestamp) AS inicio,MAX(s.run_timestamp) AS fin,COUNT(DISTINCT s.unidad_negocio_id) AS unidades,STRING_AGG(COALESCE(u.codigo,CONVERT(varchar(36),s.unidad_negocio_id)),',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.run_timestamp) AS secuencia FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 s LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio u ON CONVERT(varchar(36),u.id)=CONVERT(varchar(36),s.unidad_negocio_id) WHERE s.run_type='INCREMENTAL' AND s.run_id LIKE 'INCR-%' AND s.run_timestamp>=DATEADD(hour,-8,SYSUTCDATETIME()) GROUP BY s.run_id) SELECT TOP (30) run_id,inicio,fin,unidades,secuencia FROM x ORDER BY inicio DESC

queries.name: scheduler_unfinished_latest
queries.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT RunID,MAX(CASE WHEN Accion='START' THEN FechaAccion END) AS started,MAX(CASE WHEN Accion='FINISH' THEN FechaAccion END) AS finished FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' AND FechaAccion>=DATEADD(hour,-8,SYSUTCDATETIME()) GROUP BY RunID) SELECT TOP (30) RunID,started,finished,DATEDIFF(second,started,SYSUTCDATETIME()) AS age_seconds FROM x ORDER BY started DESC

queries.name: scheduler_lock_rows
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (50) * FROM dbo.Scheduler_DistributedLocks WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' ORDER BY ExpiresAtUtc DESC

queries.name: unit_config_current
queries.sql: SELECT codigo,nombre,system_type,CONVERT(varchar(36),server_id) AS server_id,sucursal_origen_id,activo FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio WHERE codigo IN ('130MID','CIENFUEGOS','ESTELAR','130QRO','ORIGEN') ORDER BY nombre
